_about: Premier League icons: the popular all-time players, from published all-time lists per position (data/source/research, sources below) plus Craig's own list (craig: true). consensus is 0 to 100 from how many lists name him and his average rank. peak is his verified peak seasons (evidence from data/source/honours.json and the game data: awards, Team of the Year, top scorer, Golden Glove, a title with half the games); peakSource rating means no honour was found and his best-rated season stands. honour is false where the only evidence is a title or the rating; primary marks his best peak, always a legend card, the others only where the season has room (docs/cards/ICONS.md). Built by tools/build_icons.py; scripts/build-data.py makes every peak card purple and a legend (docs/cards/ICONS.md).
